newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh cautions port as sea turns rough.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh cautions port as sea turns rough.

text.p: Bangladesh's main Chittagong port, which handles nearly 80 percent of the country's export and import, was on Sunday put on alert because of a storm brewing in the Bay of Bengal, port officials said.
They said, quoting weather officials, the sea had already become turbulent and the port had been asked to hoist distant cautionary signal number three.
"The warning came after a well-marked low had been noticed in the northwest Bay," the Chittagong meteorology office said.
The port suffered badly when a cyclone swept the coast in May, killing at least 100 people.
Chittagong and neighbouring districts are still reeling from a severe flood, caused by heavy rains earlier this month, in which more than 100 people have died, officials said.
"Some of the coastal areas were already inundated on Sunday by a one-metre high tidal surge under influence of the low," one official said.
